ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Единение» (edinenie) is 'union' throughout, «рассудок» (rassudok, 'reasoning') is kept apart from «разум» (razum, 'reason'), and «нищий Лазарь» (nishchiy Lazar') is 'the beggar Lazarus'. The in-text reference «Иоан. 17—21», printed with a dash between chapter and verse, is given as John 17:21, the verse on the union of all in God.
Source observation: [8] The in-text reference is printed «(Иоан. 17—21)», with a dash where chapter and verse would be separated; the verse meant is John 17:21 and is given so
